subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt 30 seconds as its unconditional WebSocket upgrade budget, accepting that slower handshakes will fail and reconnect?
rationale: Source, upstream ws behavior, tests, and live output establish correctness, but selecting the permanent channel availability boundary is an owner decision that CI cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the 30-second default
options.body: Land the patch as written because it matches the existing Slack policy, fixes an indefinite hang, and avoids another configuration surface.

options.title: Choose another fixed budget
options.body: Request a narrowly adjusted owner-approved timeout and rerun the same stalled-handshake and reconnect proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second default
recommendation.body: Land the patch as written because it matches the existing Slack policy, fixes an indefinite hang, and avoids another configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the reconnect and close-before-open behavior whose availability semantics this timeout activates.
